title: Establish unified Schema Registry and compatibility rules
salvageable_from_prototype: src/types.ts — type definitions are independently correct
src/migrate.ts — migration engine is independently correct
src/index.ts — schema registration and compatibility checking are correct
must_rewrite: package.json — must be private, not published
tsconfig.host.json — must add schema-registry as a reference
packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts — must register built-in schemas at boot
main_chain_gaps: Schema registry not initialized in real boot path
No built-in schemas registered at boot time
No integration proof that registry is on the main path
